## [1.6.0](https://github.com/Dan1elTheMan1el/Morphe-Patches/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-11-01)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **DeFit++:** Session distance notif compatibility for 0.9.3 ([86b7dc6](https://github.com/Dan1elTheMan1el/Morphe-Patches/commit/86b7dc6c7a75c46921a8471c6f7cfd5b910370ce))

### ✨ New Features

* **Counter:** Unlock Full Version ([48bc17e](https://github.com/Dan1elTheMan1el/Morphe-Patches/commit/48bc17efefa56da347cfb5d5786cbf9a6088c287))
* **DeFit++:** Session distance in notification text ([a47f657](https://github.com/Dan1elTheMan1el/Morphe-Patches/commit/a47f6579ac3313b170195a8cfc94448a1433c9b7))
* **YouTube:** Add support for 21.30.216 (And possibly future versions) ([fa5e113](https://github.com/Dan1elTheMan1el/Morphe-Patches/commit/fa5e1137c54007224461a189e2c0a990d82d1b6e))
* **YouTube:** Play current video in media player artwork ([64b87d0](https://github.com/Dan1elTheMan1el/Morphe-Patches/commit/64b87d008f541346951044aaa7aaf14c0fd6d288))

patches.name: Custom Branding
patches.description: Changes DeFit's app name, header title, and displayed version.

options.description: Text shown in DeFit's top action bar.
Version text shown in the app. Use "auto" to display the patched target version automatically.

patches.name: Login Fix Tutorial
patches.description: Adds an in-app Google Fit login setup guide and a button to copy the installed APK's signing SHA-1.

patches.name: Material You Theme
patches.description: Uses Android 12+ wallpaper-derived colors and enables safe system Force Dark without changing DeFit's AppCompat theme parent.

patches.name: Remove Bottom Banner Ad
patches.description: Removes DeFit's bottom banner-ad container from the main layout.

patches.name: Session Distance Notification
patches.description: Shows the total distance added during the current sync session in the persistent notification.

patches.name: Unlimited Time Bypass
patches.description: Removes the ad requirement and grants the target DeFit version's maximum active time when the button is pressed.

patches.name: Current Frame Media Artwork
patches.description: Adds an in-player control that updates the media artwork from the current video frame, including while the screen is off, and can blank the media title.

patches.name: Unlock Full Version
patches.description: Unlocks Counter's built-in full-version features, including the Color menu.

patches.name: Change keyboard name
patches.description: Changes the name shown for Keyboard Designer in Android's keyboard/input-method switcher.

options.description: The name shown by Android when switching input methods.

patches.name: Start with PokeGenie keyboard
patches.description: Adds my PokeGenie-inspired keyboard design on fresh setup and makes it the portrait text-input default.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features, extended design package, and extended keyboard package.

patches.name: Bounty Daily Reward Shortcut
patches.description: Tap Bounty to open Daily Reward; long press it to open Bounty.

patches.name: Daily Reward Background Auto-Claim
patches.description: Checks daily reward eligibility and automatically claims it (bypassing ads) if available. Invoke by sending intent as broadcast, with action app.danielthemaniel.pokeraid.CHECK_DAILY_REWARD, and package me.pokeraid.

patches.name: Disable Ads
patches.description: Disables ads locally using PokeRaid's built-in Disabled ad strategy.

patches.name: Disable Analytics
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring, and Advertising ID collection while preserving app functionality.

patches.name: Hide News Banners
patches.description: Hides PokeRaid announcement carousels without breaking Data Binding.

patches.name: Material You Theme
patches.description: Uses Android 12+ wallpaper-derived Material You colors throughout PokeRaid while preserving semantic status and raid-type colors.

patches.name: Quick Join Button
patches.description: Adds an optimistic JOIN button to room cards using PokeRaid's stock authenticated join request.
